profile: regularization parameter: The regularization parameter λ is always non-negative (λ ≥ 0). It balances the trade-off between the cost and regularizer, controlling the mixture of the two and determining how strongly one term is pressured relative to the other. In linear two-class classification and feature learning, λ is referred to as the regularization parameter.
